chapterInfo.content:
24
Ɛsɛn no. Yerusalem awieeɛ
1 # 2 Ah 25.1; Yer 52.4 Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn afe a ɛtɔ so nkron, bosome a ɛtɔ so du no da a ɛtɔ so du no sɛ: 2Onipa ba, twerɛ da yi din, da yi ara. Babel hene atua Yerusalem da yi ara. 3Na bu asowuiɛ fie no bɛ ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie:
Fa ɛsɛn no si so,
na hwie nsuo nso gu mu.
4Fa ne nankum nso gu mu,
nankum pa nyinaa, srɛ ne basa,
nnompe a ɛyɛ nyinaa, na fa hyɛ mu ma;
5fa nnwan no mu deɛ ɔyɛ no,
na fa nnyina hyehyɛ nnompe no ase
ma no nhuru yie,
na ne nnompe nso mmen wɔ mu.
6 # Hes 24.9 Ɛno nti sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie:
Due, mogya kuro!
Ɛsɛn a emu awe nnaakyen
a ne nnaakyen mfiri ne mu.
Yiyi mu adeɛ, nankum, nankum.
Wɔnnyiyi mu.
7Na ne mogya wɔ ne mu;
waka agu ɔbotan kwawee so,
wanhwie angu fam,
na wɔde dɔteɛ akata so.
8Deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na ahwanyan anibereɛ na ama aweredie aba nti,
na memaa ne mogya
guu ɔbotan pataa soɔ,
a wɔankata soɔ yi.
9 # Nah 3.1 Saa nti sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie:
Due, mogyahwiegu kuro!
Me nso mɛma aseɛ mmaboa adɔɔso.
10Ma nnyina nnɔɔso, ma ogya no nnɛre,
ma nam no nhono,
nu mu ma no mpi na nnompe no nhye.
11Na fa ɛsɛn no mpan si nsramma no so,
deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na ne kɔbere adɔ ayɛ kɔɔ,
na emu fi no anane na ne nnaakyen asa.
12Brɛ ara na mabrɛ agu,
ɛfiri sɛ ogya rentumi nhye
ne nnaakyen pii no mfiri ne ho nkɔ.
13 # Hes 5.13 Wo fi mu wɔ abusudeɛ; sɛ matwi wo ho na amfire nti,
wo ho rente mfiri wo fi no mu bio,
de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ mɛma
m’abufuhyeɛ ano adwo wo soɔ.
14Me, AWURADE, na maka. Ɛbɛba na mɛyɛ. Merennyae na merennodo ho, na merennu me ho; sɛdeɛ w’akwan teɛ ne sɛdeɛ wo nneyɛɛ teɛ no, saa ara na wɔbɛbu wo atɛn, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.
Obiara nnyam no
15Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 16#Hes 24.18 Onipa ba, hwɛ, merebɛbɔ wo de ayi w’ani adeɛ a ɛpɛ no afiri wo ho. Na ntwa adwo, nsu, na mma wo nisuo nkyi. 17Gu ahome komm, nni owufoɔ ho abooboo, fa w’abɔtire bɔ wo ti, na fa wo mpaboa hyɛ wo nan, na nkata w’ano, na nni nnipa aduane. 18Na mekasa kyerɛɛ ɔman no anɔpa, na me yere wuu anwummerɛ, na anɔpa meyɛɛ sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ me no.
19Na nkurɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Worenkyerɛ yɛn adekodeɛ a yeinom a woreyɛ yi kyerɛ wɔ yɛn ho anaa? 20Na meka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 21Kasa kyerɛ Israel fie sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Hwɛ, meregu me kronkronbea ho fi, mo ahoɔden ahokyerɛ no, mo ani adeɛ a ɛpɛ ne mo kra adeɛ a ɛdɔ no; na mo mmabanin ne mo mmammaa nkaeɛ no bɛtotɔ nkrantɛ ano. 22Na mobɛyɛ sɛdeɛ mayɛ yi, morenkata mo ano na morenni nnipa aduane, 23na mo abotire bɛbobɔ mo ti, na mo mpaboa ahyehyɛ mo nan. Morentwa adwo na morensu, na mode awerɛhoɔ bɛhunu amane wɔ mo amumuyɛ mu, na moasisi apini akyerɛkyerɛ mo ho. 24#Hes 24.27; 12.11 Na Hesekiel ayɛ mo nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ; sɛdeɛ wayɛ yi nyinaa, mobɛyɛ no berɛ a ɛbɛba mu no, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE Nyankopɔn.
25Na wo, onipa ba, ɛda no ara a mɛgye wɔn nsam ahoɔden, wɔn ahyehyɛdeɛ ho ahosɛpɛ, wɔn ani adeɛ a ɛpɛ ne wɔn kra adeɛ a ɛpɛ, wɔn mmabanin ne wɔn mmammaa no, 26#Hes 33.21 da no ara na deɛ wafiri mu afire bi bɛba wo nkyɛn abɛma w’aso ateɛ. 27Ɛda no ara na wo ne deɛ wafiri mu afire no ano bɛbue, na wobɛkasa na worentɔre mum bio, na wobɛyɛ wɔn nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ na wɔahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.

Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn afe a ɛtɔ so nkron, bosome a ɛtɔ so du no da a ɛtɔ so du no sɛ: Onipa ba, twerɛ da yi din, da yi ara. Babel hene atua Yerusalem da yi ara. Na bu asowuiɛ fie no bɛ ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie:
Fa ɛsɛn no si so,
na hwie nsuo nso gu mu.
Fa ne nankum nso gu mu,
nankum pa nyinaa, srɛ ne basa,
nnompe a ɛyɛ nyinaa, na fa hyɛ mu ma;
fa nnwan no mu deɛ ɔyɛ no,
na fa nnyina hyehyɛ nnompe no ase
ma no nhuru yie,
na ne nnompe nso mmen wɔ mu.
Ɛno nti sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie:

Ɛsɛn a emu awe nnaakyen
a ne nnaakyen mfiri ne mu.

Na ne mogya wɔ ne mu;

wanhwie angu fam,
na wɔde dɔteɛ akata so.
Deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na ahwanyan anibereɛ na ama aweredie aba nti,

guu ɔbotan pataa soɔ,
a wɔankata soɔ yi.
Saa nti sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie:
Due, mogyahwiegu kuro!
Me nso mɛma aseɛ mmaboa adɔɔso.
Ma nnyina nnɔɔso, ma ogya no nnɛre,
ma nam no nhono,
nu mu ma no mpi na nnompe no nhye.
Na fa ɛsɛn no mpan si nsramma no so,
deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na ne kɔbere adɔ ayɛ kɔɔ,
na emu fi no anane na ne nnaakyen asa.
Brɛ ara na mabrɛ agu,
ɛfiri sɛ ogya rentumi nhye
ne nnaakyen pii no mfiri ne ho nkɔ.
Wo fi mu wɔ abusudeɛ; sɛ matwi wo ho na amfire nti,
wo ho rente mfiri wo fi no mu bio,
de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ mɛma
m’abufuhyeɛ ano adwo wo soɔ.
Me, AWURADE, na maka. Ɛbɛba na mɛyɛ. Merennyae na merennodo ho, na merennu me ho; sɛdeɛ w’akwan teɛ ne sɛdeɛ wo nneyɛɛ teɛ no, saa ara na wɔbɛbu wo atɛn, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.

Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Onipa ba, hwɛ, merebɛbɔ wo de ayi w’ani adeɛ a ɛpɛ no afiri wo ho. Na ntwa adwo, nsu, na mma wo nisuo nkyi. Gu ahome komm, nni owufoɔ ho abooboo, fa w’abɔtire bɔ wo ti, na fa wo mpaboa hyɛ wo nan, na nkata w’ano, na nni nnipa aduane. Na mekasa kyerɛɛ ɔman no anɔpa, na me yere wuu anwummerɛ, na anɔpa meyɛɛ sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ me no.
Na nkurɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Worenkyerɛ yɛn adekodeɛ a yeinom a woreyɛ yi kyerɛ wɔ yɛn ho anaa? Na meka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Israel fie sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Hwɛ, meregu me kronkronbea ho fi, mo ahoɔden ahokyerɛ no, mo ani adeɛ a ɛpɛ ne mo kra adeɛ a ɛdɔ no; na mo mmabanin ne mo mmammaa nkaeɛ no bɛtotɔ nkrantɛ ano. Na mobɛyɛ sɛdeɛ mayɛ yi, morenkata mo ano na morenni nnipa aduane, na mo abotire bɛbobɔ mo ti, na mo mpaboa ahyehyɛ mo nan. Morentwa adwo na morensu, na mode awerɛhoɔ bɛhunu amane wɔ mo amumuyɛ mu, na moasisi apini akyerɛkyerɛ mo ho. Na Hesekiel ayɛ mo nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ; sɛdeɛ wayɛ yi nyinaa, mobɛyɛ no berɛ a ɛbɛba mu no, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE Nyankopɔn.
Na wo, onipa ba, ɛda no ara a mɛgye wɔn nsam ahoɔden, wɔn ahyehyɛdeɛ ho ahosɛpɛ, wɔn ani adeɛ a ɛpɛ ne wɔn kra adeɛ a ɛpɛ, wɔn mmabanin ne wɔn mmammaa no, da no ara na deɛ wafiri mu afire bi bɛba wo nkyɛn abɛma w’aso ateɛ. Ɛda no ara na wo ne deɛ wafiri mu afire no ano bɛbue, na wobɛkasa na worentɔre mum bio, na wobɛyɛ wɔn nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ na wɔahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
